chunks: So We have made this (Qur'an) easy in your tongue that you may give good news to those who take heed, and warn the people who are contentious.

key_terms.لِتُبَشِّرَ: that you may give good news

ai.seo_question: What is the purpose of the Qur'an being made easy in the Prophet's tongue?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the strategic wisdom of divine revelation being tailored to the linguistic capacity of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) to ensure effective communication. It delineates a dual mission: offering glad tidings to the God-conscious (al-muttaqin) while issuing stern warnings to the stubborn and contentious (qawman luddan), reflecting the balance between mercy and justice in prophetic duty.
